LeanEval.NumberTheory.ThueSiegelRothProblem.exists_pos_div_rpow_lt_aux✝ {x κ : ℝ} (hx : Irrational x)
  (hs : (Roth.approxSet x κ).Finite) : ∃ C, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (p q : ℤ), 0 < q → C / ↑q ^ κ < |x - ↑p / ↑q|

private theorem LeanEval.NumberTheory.ThueSiegelRothProblem.exists_pos_div_rpow_lt_aux : ∀ {x κ : ℝ},
  Irrational x → (Roth.approxSet x κ).Finite → ∃ C, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (p q : ℤ), 0 < q → C / ↑q ^ κ < |x - ↑p / ↑q| :=
fun {x κ} hx hs ↦
  let f := fun a ↦ |x - ↑a.1 / ↑a.2| * ↑a.2 ^ κ;
  Exists.casesOn
    (Set.exists_min_image (insert (0, 1) (Roth.approxSet x κ)) f (Set.Finite.insert (0, 1) hs)
      (Set.insert_nonempty (0, 1) (Roth.approxSet x κ)))
    fun a h ↦
    And.casesOn h fun ha hmin ↦
      have haq :=
        Or.casesOn ha
          (fun h ↦
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun a ↦ (∀ b ∈ insert (0, 1) (Roth.approxSet x κ), f a ≤ f b) → 0 < a.2)
              (fun hmin ↦
                Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_lt_true (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℕ (Eq.refl 0))
                  (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℕ (Eq.refl 1)) (Eq.refl false))
              (Eq.symm h) hmin)
          fun ha ↦ ha.left;
      have hfa :=
        mul_pos
          (abs_pos.mpr
            (sub_ne_zero.mpr
              (id
                (Eq.mp (congrArg (Ne x) (congrArg (HDiv.hDiv ↑a.1) (Int.cast_natCast a.2)))
                  (Irrational.ne_rational hx a.1 ↑a.2)))))
          (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Nat.cast_pos'.mpr haq) κ);
      Exists.intro (min (1 / 2) (f a / 2))
        ⟨lt_min
            (div_pos
              (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one)
                (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 1)))
              (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2))
                (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 2))))
            (div_pos hfa
              (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2))
                (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 2)))),
          fun p q hq ↦
          Exists.casesOn (CanLift.prf q (LT.lt.le hq)) fun q_1 h ↦
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun q ↦ 0 < q → min (1 / 2) (f a / 2) / ↑q ^ κ < |x - ↑p / ↑q|)
              (fun hq ↦
                have hq' :=
                  Real.rpow_pos_of_pos
                    (cast
                      (Eq.trans (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LT.lt (Eq.symm Nat.cast_zero)) ↑q_1) Nat.cast_lt._simp_1)
                        (Eq.symm
                          (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LT.lt (Eq.symm Nat.cast_zero)) ↑q_1) Nat.cast_lt._simp_1)))
                      hq)
                    κ;
                Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ min (1 / 2) (f a / 2) / _a ^ κ < |x - ↑p / _a|) (Int.cast_natCast q_1)))
                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a) (propext (div_lt_iff₀ hq'))))
                    (if hmem : (p, q_1) ∈ Roth.approxSet x κ then
                      LE.le.trans_lt (min_le_right (1 / 2) (f a / 2))
                        (LT.lt.trans_le (half_lt_self hfa) (hmin (p, q_1) (Set.mem_insert_of_mem (0, 1) hmem)))
                    else
                      LT.lt.trans_le
                        (LE.le.trans_lt (min_le_left (1 / 2) (f a / 2))
                          (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNNRat_lt_true
                            (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNNRat_div
                              (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNNRat_mul (Eq.refl HMul.hMul)
                                (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.to_isNNRat
                                  (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one))
                                (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNNRat_inv_pos
                                  (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.to_isNNRat
                                    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2))))
                                (Eq.refl (Nat.mul 1 1)) (Eq.refl 2)))
                            (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.to_isNNRat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one))
                            (Eq.refl true)))
                        (le_of_not_gt fun h ↦
                          hmem
                            ⟨cast
                                (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LT.lt (Eq.symm Nat.cast_zero)) ↑q_1) Nat.cast_lt._simp_1)
                                hq,
                              (lt_div_iff₀ hq').mpr h⟩))))
              h hq⟩

LEANEVAL_PRIVATE291_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {x κ : ℝ},
  Irrational x → (Roth.approxSet x κ).Finite → ∃ (C : ℝ), 0 < C ∧ ∀ (p q : ℤ), 0 < q → C / ↑q ^ κ < |x - ↑p / ↑q|
